label: Risk Event
temporal_semantics: occurs at/over interval; may realize scenario

label: Risk Assessment Activity
definition: An assessment process/activity producing assessment results.

label: Observation Activity
definition: An observation/monitoring activity producing observation results.
uncertainty: Monitoring broader semantics may be profile-specific.

label: Risk Treatment Activity
definition: An activity executing treatment actions/plans and possibly using controls.
participants_candidates: Risk; Treatment Plan; Control Mechanism; Actor
temporal_semantics: occurs at/over interval; effects assessed separately

label: Reassessment Activity
definition: A Risk Assessment Activity explicitly based on earlier assessment/results or changed evidence/context.
temporal_semantics: must occur after prior assessment context
uncertainty: May remain pattern rather than named subclass.

label: Ownership Assignment Activity
definition: An organizational/governance activity establishing or changing responsibility/owner assignments.
participants_candidates: Actor; Risk Responsibility; Risk Owner; Risk/Record
uncertainty: May be modeled via relator lifecycle rather than event class.

label: Workflow Transition
definition: An operational transition between Workflow States of a managed record/process.
participants_candidates: Risk Register Entry; prior/new Workflow State
uncertainty: Must not be OWL truth automatically; likely rule/application layer.

label: Risk State Transition
definition: A change between Risk States supported by assessment/event evidence.

label: Evidence Generation Activity
definition: An activity/process by which an Evidence Item is generated/collected/derived.
uncertainty: Prefer PROV-O reuse rather than local axioms.

label: Risk Register Update Activity
definition: An operational activity that creates/revises a Risk Register Entry without necessarily changing the underlying Risk.
participants_candidates: Risk Register Entry; actor; new data/evidence
uncertainty: Creation/deletion of record never entails risk creation/deletion.
